lead.event: MSCI’s proposed reclassification of Indonesia and related market fallout
lead.headline: MSCI proposes Indonesia standalone status as Goldman estimates US$5.6 billion in outflows
lead.blurb: MSCI proposed on 16 October moving Indonesia from emerging to standalone status, citing concerns over market access, ownership transparency and suspected coordinated trading. Goldman Sachs estimates full removal from MSCI indexes could bring around US$5.6 billion in passive-fund outflows. MSCI froze increases to foreign inclusion factors and share counts, halted additions and upgrades, and will continue removing stocks with concentrated ownership. Consultation runs to 30 April 2027, with a final decision due by 30 June and implementation possible from August 2027.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 4 new articles with a new fact: Goldman Sachs estimates potential passive-fund outflows of around US$5.6 billion.

market_structure_policy.event: Bank Indonesia’s October rate and reserve-requirement decisions
market_structure_policy.headline: Bank Indonesia expects reserve cuts to add around Rp190 trillion in liquidity
market_structure_policy.blurb: At its 21 October meeting, Bank Indonesia raised the deposit facility rate by 25 basis points to 5.00% and held the BI-Rate at 5.75%. Conventional-bank reserve ratios fall to 8% on 1 November and 7% on 1 December, while Islamic-bank ratios drop to 6.5% and 5.5% on those dates.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

market_structure_policy.event: IDX excludes high-concentration stocks from IHSG calculation
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX sets 2 November start for excluding high-concentration stocks from IHSG
market_structure_policy.blurb: The change also covers stocks on the Acceleration Board, while the index’s 9% cap remains unchanged. As of 21 October, 84 companies remained designated as high-shareholding-concentration stocks after IDX revoked three designations.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK sanctions parties in DSSA, BREN, and CUAN market cases
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK fines parties Rp2.1 trillion in DSSA, BREN and CUAN cases
market_structure_policy.blurb: SMT was fined Rp1.5 trillion over Dian Swastika Sentosa share manipulation, while AH Ltd and TC Pte Ltd were fined Rp500 billion and Rp100 billion, respectively, over Barito Renewables Energy and Petrindo Jaya Kreasi IPOs. OJK delivered the sanction letters on 21 October and said it was pursuing further investigation with police.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 3 new articles with a new fact: OJK said it was pursuing further investigation with the police.

earnings_guidance.event: Unilever Indonesia reports Q3 2026 earnings growth
earnings_guidance.headline: UNVR reports 26% net profit growth through Q3 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: Unilever Indonesia's sales rose 7.16% year on year to Rp25.75 trillion, with Rp18.97 trillion from home and personal care and Rp6.7 trillion from food and beverages. Gross profit fell 1.02% to Rp11.62 trillion, while operating profit rose 2.21% to Rp4.09 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: Fore Kopi reports nine-month 2026 earnings growth and outlet expansion
earnings_guidance.headline: FORE reports 49.75% nine-month 2026 profit growth as outlet network expands
earnings_guidance.blurb: Fore Kopi's revenue rose 53.3% to Rp1.59 trillion. It added more than 70 Fore Coffee outlets during the period, bringing the active total to 388 in Indonesia and five in Singapore.

earnings_guidance.event: Pembangunan Jaya Ancol reports a nine-month net profit decline
earnings_guidance.headline: PJAA reports nine-month net profit down 56.75% to Rp25.35 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Pembangunan Jaya Ancol's operating revenue slipped 2.09% to Rp781.77 billion, while operating profit fell to Rp116.8 billion from Rp164.28 billion. Basic earnings per share declined to Rp16 from Rp37.

earnings_guidance.event: Gunanusa reports nine-month net profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: GUNA reports nine-month net profit growth of 18.78% to Rp57.03 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Gunanusa's net sales rose 19.2% to Rp1.49 trillion, and basic and diluted earnings per share increased to Rp22.81 from Rp19.21.

capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Mitrabahtera Segara Sejati plans to repurchase up to 42.17 million shares, or 2.41% of its issued shares, using internal cash. The buyback is scheduled to run from 22 October to 21 January.
